Exact theta-scheme recurrence (theta = 1, 1/2, 0.7) for a fissile infinite medium with two precursor families and a ramp source, AAH and CBC, plus the discrete balance identity; compute_balance=True prints the theta-centered timestep balance after each Execute() step
Null transient from a steady state with fission, precursors, vacuum and opposing reflecting boundaries (2D/3D, AAH/CBC, theta = 1, 1/2) stays stationary
Time-dependent mode rejects cross sections without velocities (construction, mode switch, XS swap mid-transient); the rejected swap leaves the exact infinite-medium backward Euler update unchanged

Solvers revalidate and reconfigure when the problem changes after Initialize: PI after an XS swap (k_inf exact), PI rejected in time-dependent mode, transient Advance rejected in steady-state mode (exact backward Euler step after switching back)

Solvers sharing a problem do not affect each other: fixed source / PI / NLKE sequence (exact infinite-medium phi and k_inf), eigenvalue solvers reject external sources, two transient solvers with different dt (exact backward Euler steps)
Entering transient mode keeps the lagged reflecting-boundary flux (infinite-medium equilibrium)
A setter keeps time-windowed boundaries evaluated at the problem time (no-source steady solve is exactly zero)
A steady-state initial condition is loaded once; re-Initialize and a second solver continue the state and clock; a zero-state solver starts at t=0 (infinite-medium backward Euler)
WGDSA/TGDSA in transients include the time absorption 1/(v theta dt); Richardson with DSA at small and changing dt, with an XS swap, matches unaccelerated GMRES (1 rank: direct diffusion solves)

Two precursor families in an infinite medium, with use_precursors True (prompt + delayed) and False (prompt only): steady fixed-source flux with 1 or 2 groupsets, k_inf and k_p, null transients from the 1/k-critical eigenstates (theta = 1, 1/2), and the exact first prompt-only step from a supercritical state

Null transients from 1/k-critical PI and NLKE eigenstates (2D fuel/reflector, two groups with upscatter, two precursor families, AAH/CBC, theta = 1, 1/2, one or two groupsets, with and without delayed neutrons) and from an OpenMC-MGXS fixed-source steady state stay stationary
